summary.en: Compare matching field models in the Litz research checkout using its scientific conventions, shared run interface and traceable evidence.
Diagnose and recover a failed run in the Litz research checkout using its scientific conventions, shared run interface and traceable evidence.
Extend a model with verification in the Litz research checkout using its scientific conventions, shared run interface and traceable evidence.
Build evidence-backed research output in the Litz research checkout using its scientific conventions, shared run interface and traceable evidence.
Reproduce a recorded model in the Litz research checkout using its scientific conventions, shared run interface and traceable evidence.
Obtain and verify a requested academic paper through open sources or an authorized institutional browser session, retaining acquisition provenance.
Turn verified research findings and reusable implementations into an executable modeling or engineering task with explicit acceptance evidence.
Evaluate and adapt existing scientific software or agent skills, preserving licenses, upstream identity and reproducible tests.
Investigate a scientific question across literature, software, forums and reusable agent skills, with source-backed evidence and implementation options.

Align geometry, copper area, material, frequency, RMS/peak convention, axial length, terminal constraints, return and boundaries. Solve independently. Compare complex currents, power and Rac with discretization and geometry differences visible.
summary.zh-CN: 对齐几何、铜面积、材料、频率、RMS/峰值、轴向长度、端口、回流和边界；独立求解后比较复电流、功率与 Rac，同时报告离散和几何差异。

summary.en: Preserve the original failure and actual tool response. Separate transport, API, solver, resource and physical failures. Test the smallest relevant correction, record its rationale and code diff, rerun with a new identity, compare acceptance without weakening tolerances.
summary.zh-CN: 保留原失败和工具响应，定位协议、API、求解、资源或物理问题；验证最小相关修正，记录依据与差异，使用新身份重跑并核对原验收条件。

titles.en: Diagnose and recover a failed run

summary.en: State the new capability and unchanged scientific conventions. Read the equations and implementation. Save a focused code change, add independent physical/regression checks, run original and new cases, explain scope and unresolved uncertainty.
summary.zh-CN: 说明新增能力与物理条件，阅读方程和实现；保存代码差异，增加独立物理及回归检查，运行原案例与新案例，解释适用范围与不确定性。

summary.en: Use explicit accepted or diagnostic run identities. Read results and assumptions, preserve units and complex quantities, generate traceable figures, cite the canonical library, build and visually inspect the requested documents.
summary.zh-CN: 选用明确的验收或诊断运行身份，核对结果、假设、单位和复数；生成可追溯图件，引用统一题录，构建并实际阅读所需文档。

titles.zh-CN: 构建有证据支持的研究成果

summary.en: Select a model, explicit case and evidence dataset. Verify source identity and physical assumptions. Run doctor and dry-run, execute into a new run, inspect checks and compare only matching observables.
summary.zh-CN: 选择模型、案例和证据数据集，核对来源与假设；完成环境检查和预检后使用新运行号执行，解释验收并比较一致的观测量。
